title: Dedicated: document burst capacity option (API fields, examples, troubleshooting)
author: Kira Thompson
description: Summary: Updates Redwood Dedicated documentation to cover the new Burst Capacity option for private beta. Adds customer-facing API/Console fields, request/response semantics, examples, and troubleshooting guidance; also includes beta caveats (shadow metering, best-effort behavior under contention, and how to interpret burst-denied responses). Context: This PR is the docs deliverable for ENG-4829 and incorporates learnings from pilot feedback around error messaging and retries (SUP-3277). What’s included: (1) Dedicated Burst overview page describing baseline vs burst capacity, eligibility, and expected behaviors; (2) API reference updates for tenant/billing configuration fields and new response headers; (3) examples (curl + SDK-ish pseudo snippets) for enabling burst and observing admission/denial; (4) troubleshooting section for common issues (high reject rate, unexpected 429/503, cooldown behavior, region constraints) with recommended next steps and what to send Support; (5) beta caveats box with explicit limitations and monitoring checklist. Not included: pricing tables beyond beta language, GA commitments on preemption/eviction, or internal-only operational runbooks. Verification: built docs site locally; ran link checker; confirmed terminology aligns with Product’s packaging notes and SRE’s current guidance on deny semantics (429 when limits/cooldowns are hit, 503 when pool health is degraded/unavailable; both cases include a safe reason code header).
commits: docs(dedicated): add burst capacity overview + beta caveats
docs(api): document burst config fields + response headers
docs(troubleshooting): add burst deny semantics, retries, and monitoring checklist
chore: fix broken links + unify terminology (burst pool vs burst capacity)
conversation: Lauren Bishop (Product): Can we make the beta terms more explicit that billing is shadow-metered and not yet invoiced? Also, please avoid promising ‘guaranteed burst’ anywhere.

Kira Thompson (Author): Updated the beta caveats callout to: ‘Burst usage will be metered and visible during beta; invoicing is shadow-only unless otherwise agreed in your order form.’ Also replaced two instances of ‘guaranteed’ with ‘best-effort subject to admission control.’

Sean Gallagher (SRE): Troubleshooting section should explicitly call out what customers will see when burst is denied. We’ve had confusion between 429 vs 503; include headers and a recommendation to back off on 429 (cooldown/limit) and to fail over/queue on 503 (pool degraded).

Kira Thompson (Author): Added a ‘Burst denied: what it means’ subsection with a table (HTTP code → likely cause → recommended action) and documented the headers: `x-redwood-burst-admitted` (true|false), `x-redwood-burst-deny-reason` (enum), and `retry-after` on 429. Linked SUP-3277 in the internal note for Support escalation.

Mina Haddad (Routing): Please be careful describing fallback semantics; we do baseline → burst (if eligible) → regional fallback only if customer has multi-region enabled, otherwise deny. The current text reads like we always attempt another region automatically.

Kira Thompson (Author): Good catch—updated the fallback paragraph to: ‘Fallback behavior depends on your tenant routing policy; by default requests remain in-region.’ Added a short note pointing to the ‘Dedicated Regions & Routing’ page and removed implied automatic cross-region behavior.
Nadia Rahman (Metering): On the API fields, can we avoid naming anything ‘overage’ in beta? We’re still calling it ‘burst usage attribution’ and ‘shadow metering’ until packaging is final.
Kira Thompson (Author): Updated wording from ‘overage’ to ‘burst usage’ throughout; removed one heading that said ‘Overage visibility’ and replaced with ‘Burst usage visibility (beta)’.
Elliot Price (Docs): Minor: the new headers doc should mention that reason codes are stable but may expand; also please keep the header names lowercase in code blocks to match our style guide.
Kira Thompson (Author): Done—added a note about forward-compatible enums and normalized header names in examples.
Lauren Bishop (Product): Approved after wording changes.
Sean Gallagher (SRE): Approved; thanks for the clear retry guidance.
release_notes: Docs: Added Dedicated Burst Capacity (beta) documentation including configuration fields, response headers, examples, and troubleshooting guidance.
